intro: Worn Parchments are fragmented ritual writings carried by cultists encamped around the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. Gathered by scouts, these tattered scraps provide the first concrete clues identifying the sinister sect gathering in the ruins.

p: North along the mist-shrouded coast of Darkshore, dark spellcasters and their zealous followers have seized the ruined Tower of Althalaxx. The foot soldiers patrolling the grounds outside, known as Dark Strand Fanatics, carry scraps of worn parchment among their personal effects. While a single piece appears as nothing more than fragmented scribbles and esoteric symbols, piecing together multiple fragments reveals the presence of a previously unknown organization: the Cult of the Dark Strand.
